tldr: Jupiter in the 8th house: growth becomes personal through shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change.
body:
With Jupiter in the 8th house, this part of you expands through shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change. Jupiter describes growth, faith, appetite, opportunity, generosity, and the need for a wider view. In practice, this brings attention to what you share, owe, merge with, grieve, fear, desire, or struggle to control.

When this placement is supported, you can become more honest about trust, attachment, and what is actually shared. Jupiter can become hope, confidence, perspective, generosity, and a larger sense of possibility.

When it is strained, control, secrecy, or fear can make closeness feel heavier than it needs to be. The harder pattern can show up as overextension, excess, overpromising, or assuming more is always better.
gift: hope, confidence, perspective, generosity, and a larger sense of possibility expressed through shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change.
challenge: overextension, excess, overpromising, or assuming more is always better around shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change.
